command_or_source: Launched build/Tocode.app and drove the status-bar menu with CGEvent synthesis. Verified two screen-saver-level (layer 1000) Tocode overlay windows covering both displays (1512x982 and 1920x1080), black fill with gray centered label; verified single left-mouse click and single keyboard key both dismiss all overlays (layer 1000 windows return to 0).
result_summary: Runtime menu activation, per-screen black overlays, and dismissal via arbitrary keyboard and mouse input were exercised successfully. A first-mouse-only-activates-window bug was found during testing and fixed by overriding acceptsFirstMouse(for:) on the content view.
limitations: Driven through synthesized CGEvent input rather than physical human hardware; results match the declared behavior but should still be sanity-checked by the user on their real keyboard/mouse.
The two displays differ in resolution; both were covered but no additional displays were attached.
